lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg12Zn2 (reduced formula Mg6Zn) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6₃/mmc (No. 194), with 14 atoms in the unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows all Mg and Zn centers adopt 12-neighbor close-packed-like local arrangements, with Mg–Mg, Mg–Zn, and Zn–Mg neighbor distances of 3.07–3.17 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 14 sites, and validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include Mg–Mg 12-vertex polyhedra exhibiting corner, edge, and face sharing.
